technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum and breakout signals conflicted by extreme overbought conditions and weak intermediate trend structure; moderate swing entry with elevated reversal risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (339.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 91 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + DC20 new high + RSI extreme overbought (89.74) signals strong short-term momentum breakout with price near 52-week highs, offering contrarian opportunity in fear-zone market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (89.74, 85.26) without intermediate trend confirmation (EMA 20/50 misaligned, ADX weak, price below Ichimoku cloud), combined with crisis VIX, unfavorable macro, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered strategy creates high reversal risk with poor risk/reward at resistance.
